RWAEvidence.description: Response evidence envelope, contract v1.2. payload_hash is genuine and recomputable without any key. The legacy ES256K body signature is NOT produced and is NOT verifiable - it is reported with an explicit status instead of being advertised. Canonical execution and response-hash evidence is the Ed25519 execution receipt referenced by the x-nomos-receipt-url response header.

payload_hash.description: sha256 over this response with the 'evidence' member removed, JSON encoded with sorted keys and compact separators. Needs no key and no external service.

signature.description: Legacy ES256K body signature. Currently never produced; treat as absent, never as verified.

kid.description: null while no signature exists - a key id names the key that signed, and with no signature it names nothing.

verification.description: Verification surface for the legacy ES256K signature above.

jwks_url.description: null. The URL formerly advertised here returned 404 and no reachable JWKS publishes the legacy kid.

verifier_kit.description: null. The URL formerly advertised here answered 200 with valid:false - an alive-looking surface that verifies nothing.

canonical_execution_evidence.description: Pointer to the evidence that IS verifiable. Ed25519/EdDSA - a different algorithm and a different key than the ES256K field above, and not a replacement JWKS for it.

RWAXrplDetail.description: Enhanced fields for XRPL native assets

RWARedemptionProfile.description: Institutional liquidity profile - how fast can you exit to cash?

liquidity_latency_score.description: Composite score (0-100): higher = faster exit to cash

NomosExecutionReceipt.description: Ed25519-signed execution receipt. Canonical response-hash evidence.

receipt.description: Receipt core. Verify by recomputing the digest over the canonical core (JSON, sorted keys, compact separators) and checking the signature over b'nomos.execution.receipt.v1' + 0x00 + canonical(core).

response_sha256.description: Signed hash of the delivered response body. Compare against your own hash of the bytes you received and against x-content-hash.

get.summary: Read the signed execution receipt for one call
get.description:
Returns the Ed25519-signed execution receipt for a single earlier request. Take the URL from that request's x-nomos-receipt-url response header rather than building it.

The receipt is served only to the consumer that owns it. Unknown, foreign, malformed and not-yet-signed ids are deliberately indistinguishable from outside: all four answer 404 RECEIPT_NOT_AVAILABLE. There is no listing endpoint.

A receipt read performs no business call: it creates no execution, no decision and no new receipt (measured: 12 reads, row delta 0/0/0).

401.description: Missing, malformed, unknown, expired or revoked credential

404.description: RECEIPT_NOT_AVAILABLE - uniform answer for unknown, foreign, malformed and unsigned ids

405.description: Method not allowed (GET and HEAD only)

429.description: Rate limited (receipt reads are limited per key, separately from the business routes)
